title: Stairway to the Green Moon
description: A lone figure in a flowing red cloak ascends a stone staircase that curves through the sky, framed by an ornate floral arch with blooming yellow branches. In the background, a large green moon with purple rings hovers above purple mountains, a winding blue river, and a vibrant, swirling sunset sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy landscape featuring a hooded figure in a long red cloak climbing a winding stone staircase that rises through the air. The stairs are entwined with yellow flowering vines and framed by an ornate decorative arch filled with purple and pink blossoms. In the distance, a massive green moon with glowing purple rings floats above jagged purple mountains and a winding blue river valley. The sky is a dramatic swirling mix of orange, blue, and turquoise clouds. A small red sign reads STASIS on the left side of the arch.
